_comment: Verified prices for models this project will actually run, kept outside the
fetched catalogue on purpose. logs/groq_models.json is an API snapshot and is
overwritten wholesale by a refresh, so prices written into it would be
silently erased by the next sync. This file is the durable, reviewable record.
The provider's /models endpoint publishes no prices, so every entry here is
hand-entered from a named source and carries the date it was read. A price
that is not in this table is unknown, and the budget guard refuses calls to
unknown models rather than treating them as free.
Units are US dollars per one million tokens, matching how providers publish.
The loader converts to per-token before the budget guard ever sees them; do
